title: Jolteon’s Lungs Make Electricity
premise: Jolteon’s breath crackles because its lungs contain an organ that creates electricity.
audiencePromise: Trace Jolteon’s crackling breath from the sound, to its lungs, to the organ creating electricity.
openLoop: What links Jolteon’s lungs to its crackling breath?
payoff: Jolteon’s electricity can spark in its fur and crackle in its breath.
engagementQuestion: Which is stranger: sparking fur or crackling breath?

voice.instructions: Speak like a knowledgeable fan sharing a strange discovery. Keep the pace quick, warm, and clear. Stress lungs, electricity, and crackle. Pause briefly before each reveal.

scenes.headline: ITS LUNGS MAKE ELECTRICITY
scenes.narration: Jolteon’s breath crackles because its lungs make electricity.
scenes.caption: ELECTRICITY FROM ITS LUNGS

scenes.headline: LISTEN WHEN IT EXHALES
scenes.narration: Its Pokédex says electricity crackles when Jolteon exhales.
scenes.caption: ELECTRICITY CRACKLES WHEN IT EXHALES

scenes.headline: FUR ISN’T THE WHOLE STORY
scenes.narration: Its fur already crackles, but the lungs hold an organ.
scenes.caption: FUR SPARKS. LUNGS HOLD AN ORGAN.

scenes.headline: THE ORGAN CREATES ELECTRICITY
scenes.narration: That organ inside its lungs creates electricity.
scenes.caption: THE ORGAN CREATES ELECTRICITY

scenes.headline: YOU CAN HEAR THE POWER
scenes.narration: When Jolteon exhales, you can hear electricity crackle.
scenes.caption: YOU CAN HEAR ELECTRICITY CRACKLE
